title.zh: 卷六十九 表第九 方鎮六
title.raw: 卷六十九 表第九 方鎮六 Volume 69 Tables 9: Military Commanderies 6

sentences.zh: 西元 衡州 黔州 嶺南 邕管 容管 桂管 安南

translations.literal: Western calendar [CE]. Hengzhou. Qianzhou. Lingnan. Yong Circuit. Rong Circuit. Gui Circuit. Annan.
translations.idiomatic: CE dates. Columns: Hengzhou; Qianzhou; Lingnan; Yong; Rong; Gui; Annan.

translations.literal: 710, first year of the Jingyun era.
translations.idiomatic: 710 CE, first year of the Jingyun reign.

sentences.zh: 桂州，開耀後置管內經略使，領桂、梧、賀、連、柳、富、昭、蒙、嚴、環融、古、思唐、龔十四州，治桂州。

translations.literal: After Kaiyao, a Guizhou intra-circuit frontier commissioner was established, holding Gui, Wu, He, Lian, Liu, Fu, Zhao, Meng, Yan, Huanrong, Gu, Sitang, and Gong prefectures—fourteen in all—with seat at Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: After the Kaiyao era, a Guizhou intra-circuit frontier commissioner was appointed, commanding fourteen prefectures—Gui, Wu, He, Lian, Liu, Fu, Zhao, Meng, Yan, Huanrong, Gu, Sitang, and Gong—from his seat at Guizhou.

translations.literal: 712, first year of the Xiantian era.
translations.idiomatic: 712 CE, first year of the Xiantian reign.

translations.literal: 713, first year of the Kaiyuan era.
translations.idiomatic: 713 CE, first year of the Kaiyuan reign.

sentences.zh: 黔州置五溪諸州經略使。

translations.literal: At Qianzhou the Wuxi frontier commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: A Wuxi frontier commissioner was established at Qianzhou.

translations.literal: 742, first year of the Tianbao era.
translations.idiomatic: 742 CE, first year of the Tianbao reign.

sentences.zh: 置安南管內經略使，領交、陸、峰、愛、驩、長、福祿、芝、武峨、演、武安十一州，治交州。

translations.literal: The Annan intra-circuit frontier commissioner was established, holding Jiao, Lu, Feng, Ai, Huan, Chang, Fulu, Zhi, Wu'e, Yan, and Wu'an prefectures—eleven in all—with seat at Jiaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: An Annan intra-circuit frontier commissioner was appointed, commanding eleven prefectures—Jiao, Lu, Feng, Ai, Huan, Chang, Fulu, Zhi, Wu'e, Yan, and Wu'an—from his seat at Jiaozhou.

sentences.zh: 五溪經略使增領守捉使。

translations.literal: The Wuxi frontier commissioner added the garrison commissioner to his jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Wuxi frontier commissioner also took charge of the garrison commissioner.

sentences.zh: 置邕州管內經略使，領邕、貴、橫、欽、澄、賓、嚴、羅、淳、瀼、山、田、籠十三州，治邕州。

translations.literal: The Yongzhou intra-circuit frontier commissioner was established, holding Yong, Gui, Heng, Qin, Cheng, Bin, Yan, Luo, Chun, Rang, Shan, Tian, and Long prefectures—thirteen in all—with seat at Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: A Yongzhou intra-circuit frontier commissioner was appointed, commanding thirteen prefectures—Yong, Gui, Heng, Qin, Cheng, Bin, Yan, Luo, Chun, Rang, Shan, Tian, and Long—from his seat at Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 置容州管內經略使，領容、白、禺、牢、繡、黨、竇、廉、義、鬱林、湯、巖、辯、平琴十四州，治容州。

translations.literal: The Rongzhou intra-circuit frontier commissioner was established, holding Rong, Bai, Yu, Lao, Xiu, Dang, Dou, Lian, Yi, Yulin, Tang, Yan, Bian, and Pingqin prefectures—fourteen in all—with seat at Rongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: A Rongzhou intra-circuit frontier commissioner was appointed, commanding fourteen prefectures—Rong, Bai, Yu, Lao, Xiu, Dang, Dou, Lian, Yi, Yulin, Tang, Yan, Bian, and Pingqin—from his seat at Rongzhou.

translations.literal: 756, first year of the Zhide era.
translations.idiomatic: 756 CE, first year of the Zhide reign.

sentences.zh: 升五府經略討擊使為嶺南節度使，領廣、韶、循、潮、康、瀧、端、新、封、春、勤、羅、潘、高、恩、雷、崖、瓊、振、儋、萬安、籐二十二州，治廣州。

translations.literal: The Five Prefectures frontier pacification commissioner was promoted to Lingnan military commissioner, holding Guang, Shao, Xun, Chao, Kang, Long, Duan, Xin, Feng, Chun, Qin, Luo, Pan, Gao, En, Lei, Ya, Qiong, Zhen, Dan, Wan'an, and Teng prefectures—twenty-two in all—with seat at Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Five Prefectures frontier pacification commissioner was raised to Lingnan military commissioner, commanding twenty-two prefectures—Guang, Shao, Xun, Chao, Kang, Long, Duan, Xin, Feng, Chun, Qin, Luo, Pan, Gao, En, Lei, Ya, Qiong, Zhen, Dan, Wan'an, and Teng—from his seat at Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 置衡州防禦使，領衡、涪、岳、潭、郴、邵、永、道八州，治衡州。

translations.literal: The Hengzhou defense commissioner was established, holding Heng, Fu, Yue, Tan, Chen, Shao, Yong, and Dao prefectures—eight in all—with seat at Hengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: A Hengzhou defense commissioner was installed, commanding Heng, Fu, Yue, Tan, Chen, Shao, Yong, and Dao from his seat at Hengzhou.

translations.literal: 758, first year of the Qianyuan era.
translations.idiomatic: 758 CE, first year of the Qianyuan reign.

translations.literal: The Hengzhou defense commissioner ceased holding Chen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Hengzhou defense commissioner relinquished Chen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 置韶、連、郴三州都團練守捉使，治韶州。

translations.literal: The Shaozhou, Lianzhou, and Chenzhou chief training and garrison commissioner was established, with seat at Shaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: A chief training and garrison commissioner for Shaozhou, Lianzhou, and Chenzhou was installed at Shaozhou.

sentences.zh: 邕州管內經略使兼都防禦使，增領羅州。

translations.literal: The Yongzhou intra-circuit frontier commissioner, who also served as chief defense commissioner, added Luo Prefecture to his jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongzhou intra-circuit frontier commissioner, doubling as chief defense commissioner, gained jurisdiction over Luo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 升安南管內經略使為節度使。

translations.literal: The Annan intra-circuit frontier commissioner was promoted to military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Annan intra-circuit frontier commissioner was raised to military commissioner.

translations.literal: Fu Prefecture was placed under the Jingnan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Prefecture was transferred to the Jingnan circuit.

translations.literal: Yue Prefecture was placed under the E-Yue training commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Prefecture was assigned to the E-Yue training commissioner.

sentences.zh: 升邕州管內都防禦經略使為節度使。

translations.literal: The Yongzhou intra-circuit chief defense and frontier commissioner was promoted to military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongzhou intra-circuit chief defense and frontier commissioner was raised to military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 容州管內經略使增領都防禦使。

translations.literal: The Rongzhou intra-circuit frontier commissioner added the chief defense commissioner to his jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Rongzhou intra-circuit frontier commissioner also took charge of the chief defense commissioner.

translations.literal: 760, first year of the Shangyuan era.
translations.idiomatic: 760 CE, first year of the Shangyuan reign.

sentences.zh: 廢邕州管內節度使，置都防禦經略使。

translations.literal: The Yongzhou intra-circuit military commissioner was abolished; a chief defense and frontier commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongzhou intra-circuit military commissioner was abolished and replaced by a chief defense and frontier commissioner.

sentences.zh: 升容州經略都防禦使為觀察使。

translations.literal: The Rongzhou frontier chief defense commissioner was promoted to observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Rongzhou frontier chief defense commissioner was raised to observation commissioner.

translations.literal: The Hengzhou defense commissioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Hengzhou defense commissioner was abolished.

sentences.zh: 廢韶、連、郴都團練使，三州復隸嶺南節度。

translations.literal: The Shaozhou, Lianzhou, and Chenzhou chief training commissioner was abolished; the three prefectures were again placed under the Lingnan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The chief training commissioner for Shaozhou, Lianzhou, and Chenzhou was abolished, and the three prefectures reverted to the Lingnan circuit.

sentences.zh: 羅、潘二州隸邕管觀察使。

translations.literal: Luo and Pan prefectures were placed under the Yong circuit observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Luo and Pan prefectures were transferred to the Yong circuit observation commissioner.

translations.literal: 762, first year of the Baoying era.
translations.idiomatic: 762 CE, first year of the Baoying reign.

translations.literal: 763, first year of the Guangde era.
translations.idiomatic: 763 CE, first year of the Guangde reign.

sentences.zh: 置湖南都團練守捉觀察處置使，治衡州，領衡、潭、邵、永、道五州，治衡州。

translations.literal: The Hunan chief training, garrison, observation, and disposal commissioner was established, with seat at Hengzhou, holding Heng, Tan, Shao, Yong, and Dao prefectures—five in all—with seat at Hengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: A Hunan chief training, garrison, observation, and disposal commissioner was installed at Hengzhou, commanding Heng, Tan, Shao, Yong, and Dao.

sentences.zh: 廢邕州管內都防禦使，以所管州隸桂管經略使。

translations.literal: The Yongzhou intra-circuit chief defense commissioner was abolished; the prefectures under his charge were placed under the Gui circuit frontier commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongzhou intra-circuit chief defense commissioner was abolished, and his prefectures were transferred to the Gui circuit frontier commissioner.

sentences.zh: 置桂邕都防禦、觀察、招討、處置等使，增領邕管諸州。

translations.literal: The Gui-Yong chief defense, observation, pacification, and disposal commissioner was established, adding the Yong circuit prefectures to his jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: A Gui–Yong chief defense, observation, pacification, and disposal commissioner was created, with the Yong circuit prefectures added to his command.

sentences.zh: 改安南節度使為鎮南大都護、都防禦、觀察、經略使。

translations.literal: The Annan military commissioner was changed to Protector-General of Zhennan, chief defense, observation, and frontier commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Annan military commissioner was redesignated Protector-General of Zhennan with the combined posts of chief defense, observation, and frontier commissioner.

translations.literal: 765, first year of the Yongtai era.
translations.idiomatic: 765 CE, first year of the Yongtai reign.

translations.literal: 766, first year of the Dali era.
translations.idiomatic: 766 CE, first year of the Dali reign.

translations.literal: The Hunan observation commissioner moved his seat to Tanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Hunan observation commissioner transferred his seat to Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 置辰、溪、巫、錦、業五州都團練守捉觀察處置使，治辰州。

translations.literal: The Chen, Xi, Wu, Jin, and Ye chief training, garrison, observation, and disposal commissioner was established, with seat at Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: A chief training, garrison, observation, and disposal commissioner for Chen, Xi, Wu, Jin, and Ye was installed at Chenzhou.

sentences.zh: 復置邕州管內都防禦使。

translations.literal: The Yongzhou intra-circuit chief defense commissioner was reestablished.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongzhou intra-circuit chief defense commissioner was restored.

sentences.zh: 桂管觀察使罷領邕管諸州。

translations.literal: The Gui circuit observation commissioner ceased holding the Yong circuit prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: The Gui circuit observation commissioner relinquished the Yong circuit prefectures.

sentences.zh: 邕州管內都防禦使增領桂管諸州。

translations.literal: The Yongzhou intra-circuit chief defense commissioner added the Gui circuit prefectures to his jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongzhou intra-circuit chief defense commissioner gained jurisdiction over the Gui circuit prefectures.

sentences.zh: 罷桂管觀察使，以諸州隸邕管。

translations.literal: The Gui circuit observation commissioner was abolished; the prefectures were placed under the Yong circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Gui circuit observation commissioner was abolished, and his prefectures were transferred to the Yong circuit.

sentences.zh: 置黔州經略招討觀察使，領黔、施、夷、辰、思、費、漵、播、南、溱、珍、錦十二州，治黔州。

translations.literal: The Qianzhou frontier pacification and observation commissioner was established, holding Qian, Shi, Yi, Chen, Si, Fei, Xu, Bo, Nan, Qin, Zhen, and Jin prefectures—twelve in all—with seat at Qianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: A Qianzhou frontier pacification and observation commissioner was appointed, commanding twelve prefectures—Qian, Shi, Yi, Chen, Si, Fei, Xu, Bo, Nan, Qin, Zhen, and Jin—from his seat at Qianzhou.

translations.literal: 780, first year of the Jianzhong era.
translations.idiomatic: 780 CE, first year of the Jianzhong reign.

sentences.zh: 容管觀察使增領順、籐二州。

translations.literal: The Rong circuit observation commissioner added Shun and Teng prefectures to his jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Rong circuit observation commissioner gained jurisdiction over Shun and Teng.

translations.literal: 784, first year of the Xingyuan era.
translations.idiomatic: 784 CE, first year of the Xingyuan reign.

translations.literal: 785, first year of the Zhenyuan era.
translations.idiomatic: 785 CE, first year of the Zhenyuan reign.

sentences.zh: 黔州觀察使徙治辰州，增領獎、溪二州。

translations.literal: The Qianzhou observation commissioner moved his seat to Chenzhou, adding Jiang and Xi prefectures to his jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Qianzhou observation commissioner transferred his seat to Chenzhou and gained Jiang and Xi.

sentences.zh: 邕州都防禦使罷領桂管諸州，增領潯州。

translations.literal: The Yongzhou chief defense commissioner ceased holding the Gui circuit prefectures and added Xun Prefecture to his jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongzhou chief defense commissioner relinquished the Gui circuit prefectures and gained Xun Prefecture.

translations.literal: The Gui circuit frontier pacification commissioner was reestablished.
translations.idiomatic: The Gui circuit frontier pacification commissioner was restored.

translations.literal: The Qianzhou observation commissioner restored his seat at Qianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Qianzhou observation commissioner returned his seat to Qianzhou.

sentences.zh: 桂管經略使罷領招討使。

translations.literal: The Gui circuit frontier commissioner ceased holding the pacification commissioner post.
translations.idiomatic: The Gui circuit frontier commissioner relinquished the pacification commissioner post.

translations.literal: 805, first year of the Yongzhen era.
translations.idiomatic: 805 CE, first year of the Yongzhen reign.

translations.literal: Rang, Tian, and Shan prefectures were eliminated.
translations.idiomatic: Rang, Tian, and Shan prefectures were struck from the rolls.

translations.literal: 806, first year of the Yuanhe era.
translations.idiomatic: 806 CE, first year of the Yuanhe reign.

sentences.zh: 嶺南節度復領潘、辯二州。

translations.literal: The Lingnan military commissioner regained jurisdiction over Pan and Bian prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: The Lingnan circuit regained Pan and Bian prefectures.

sentences.zh: 邕州管內都防禦觀察經略使增領懷遠軍使。

translations.literal: The Yongzhou intra-circuit chief defense, observation, and frontier commissioner added the Huaiyuan Army commissioner to his jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongzhou intra-circuit chief defense, observation, and frontier commissioner also took charge of the Huaiyuan Army commissioner.

translations.literal: Yan Prefecture was placed under the Rong circuit observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Prefecture was assigned to the Rong circuit observation commissioner.

translations.literal: Luo Prefecture was placed under the Lingnan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Prefecture was transferred to the Lingnan circuit.

translations.literal: Bian Prefecture was placed under the Lingnan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Bian Prefecture was transferred to the Lingnan circuit.

translations.literal: Yan Prefecture was placed under the Gui circuit observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Prefecture was assigned to the Gui circuit observation commissioner.
Tang Prefecture was struck from the rolls.

translations.literal: The Gui circuit frontier commissioner added Yan Prefecture to his jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Gui circuit frontier commissioner gained jurisdiction over Yan Prefecture.

translations.literal: The Qianzhou observation commissioner added Fu Prefecture to his jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Qianzhou observation commissioner gained jurisdiction over Fu Prefecture.

translations.literal: The Yong circuit frontier commissioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Yong circuit frontier commissioner was abolished.

translations.literal: 821, first year of the Changqing era.
translations.idiomatic: 821 CE, first year of the Changqing reign.

translations.literal: The Yong circuit frontier commissioner was reestablished.
translations.idiomatic: The Yong circuit frontier commissioner was restored.

translations.literal: 825, first year of the Baoli era.
translations.idiomatic: 825 CE, first year of the Baoli reign.

translations.literal: 827, first year of the Dahe era.
translations.idiomatic: 827 CE, first year of the Dahe reign.

translations.literal: 836, first year of the Kaicheng era.
translations.idiomatic: 836 CE, first year of the Kaicheng reign.

translations.literal: 841, first year of the Huichang era.
translations.idiomatic: 841 CE, first year of the Huichang reign.

translations.literal: 847, first year of the Dazhong era.
translations.idiomatic: 847 CE, first year of the Dazhong reign.

sentences.zh: 涪州隸荊南節度，未幾，復隸黔州觀察。

translations.literal: Fu Prefecture was placed under the Jingnan circuit; shortly afterward it was transferred back to the Qianzhou observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Prefecture was assigned to the Jingnan circuit, but soon reverted to the Qianzhou observation commissioner.

translations.literal: 860, first year of the Xiantong era.
translations.idiomatic: 860 CE, first year of the Xiantong reign.

sentences.zh: 邕管經略使增領容管十一州，尋皆罷領。

translations.literal: The Yong circuit frontier commissioner added the eleven Rong circuit prefectures to his jurisdiction; soon all were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: The Yong circuit frontier commissioner briefly gained the eleven Rong circuit prefectures, but soon relinquished them all.

sentences.zh: 廢容管觀察使，以所管十一州隸邕管經略使，未幾復置，領州如故。

translations.literal: The Rong circuit observation commissioner was abolished; the eleven prefectures under his charge were placed under the Yong circuit frontier commissioner. Shortly afterward he was reestablished, with his prefectures as before.
translations.idiomatic: The Rong circuit observation commissioner was abolished and his eleven prefectures transferred to the Yong circuit frontier commissioner; he was soon restored with his former prefectures.

sentences.zh: 分嶺南節度為東西道，改嶺南節度為嶺南東道節度。

translations.literal: Lingnan military commissioner was divided into eastern and western circuits; Lingnan military commissioner was redesignated Lingnan East Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Lingnan circuit was split into eastern and western commands, with the original Lingnan military commissioner redesignated Lingnan East Circuit.

sentences.zh: 升邕管經略使為嶺南西道節度使，增領蒙州。

translations.literal: The Yong circuit frontier commissioner was promoted to Lingnan West Circuit military commissioner, adding Meng Prefecture to his jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Yong circuit frontier commissioner was raised to Lingnan West Circuit military commissioner and gained Meng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 升安南都護為靜海軍節度使。

translations.literal: The Annan protector was promoted to Jinghai Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Annan protector was raised to Jinghai Army military commissioner.

translations.literal: 874, first year of the Qianfu era.
translations.idiomatic: 874 CE, first year of the Qianfu reign.

translations.literal: 880, first year of the Guangming era.
translations.idiomatic: 880 CE, first year of the Guangming reign.

translations.literal: 881, first year of the Zhonghe era.
translations.idiomatic: 881 CE, first year of the Zhonghe reign.

sentences.zh: 升湖南觀察使為欽化軍節度。

translations.literal: The Hunan observation commissioner was promoted to Qinhua Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Hunan observation commissioner was raised to Qinhua Army circuit.

translations.literal: 885, first year of the Guangqi era.
translations.idiomatic: 885 CE, first year of the Guangqi reign.

sentences.zh: 改欽化軍節度為武安軍節度使。

translations.literal: The Qinhua Army circuit was changed to the Wu'an Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Qinhua Army circuit was redesignated the Wu'an Army military commissioner.

translations.literal: 888, first year of the Wende era.
translations.idiomatic: 888 CE, first year of the Wende reign.

translations.literal: 889, first year of the Longji era.
translations.idiomatic: 889 CE, first year of the Longji reign.

translations.literal: 890, first year of the Dashun era.
translations.idiomatic: 890 CE, first year of the Dashun reign.

sentences.zh: 賜黔州觀察使號武泰軍節度。

translations.literal: The Qianzhou observation commissioner was granted the designation Wutai Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Qianzhou observation commissioner received the title Wutai Army circuit.

translations.literal: 892, first year of the Jingfu era.
translations.idiomatic: 892 CE, first year of the Jingfu reign.

translations.literal: 894, first year of the Qianning era.
translations.idiomatic: 894 CE, first year of the Qianning reign.

sentences.zh: 賜嶺南東道節度號清海軍節度。

translations.literal: The Lingnan East Circuit was granted the designation Qinghai Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Lingnan East Circuit received the title Qinghai Army circuit.

sentences.zh: 升容管觀察使為寧遠軍節度使。

translations.literal: The Rong circuit observation commissioner was promoted to Ningyuan Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Rong circuit observation commissioner was raised to Ningyuan Army military commissioner.

translations.literal: 898, first year of the Guanghua era.
translations.idiomatic: 898 CE, first year of the Guanghua reign.

translations.literal: Xu Prefecture was placed under the Wuzhen Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Prefecture was transferred to the Wuzhen Army circuit.

sentences.zh: 升桂管經略使為靜江軍節度使。

translations.literal: The Gui circuit frontier commissioner was promoted to Jingjiang Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Gui circuit frontier commissioner was raised to Jingjiang Army military commissioner.

translations.literal: 901, first year of the Tianfu era.
translations.idiomatic: 901 CE, first year of the Tianfu reign.

translations.literal: The Wutai Army circuit moved its seat to Fu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Wutai Army circuit transferred its seat to Fu Prefecture.

translations.literal: 904, first year of the Tianyou era.
translations.idiomatic: 904 CE, first year of the Tianyou reign.
